Figure 9: Backhaul hop count CDF of different IAB spanning tree topologies (seven donors) Figure 9 compares the backhaul hop count CDF of RSRP based spanning tree and RSRP plus load based spanning tree. The backhaul hop count CDF of RSRP plus load based spanning tree is to the left of RSRP based spanning tree. This illustrates that RSRP and load based spanning tree reduces the number of backhaul hops, with respect to RSRP based spanning tree. Observation 5: Consideration of load, while generating topology, reduces the number of backhaul hops in IAB networks.
